SELECT favorite.goalId, favorite.categoryId, favorite.title, favorite.amount, favorite.detail FROM (
SELECT tg.goal_id AS goalId, 1 AS categoryId, tg.title AS title, COALESCE(tc.total_cost, 0) AS amount, tg.destination AS detail, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN travel_goal tg ON ub.goal_id = tg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 1 AND tg.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN travel_cost tc ON tg.goal_id = tc.goal_id AND tc.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND tg.status = 'CONFIRMED'
UNION ALL
SELECT jg.goal_id AS goalId, 2 AS categoryId, jc.category_name AS title, ( COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(jgq.selected_cost) FROM job_goal_qualification jgq WHERE jgq.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgq.del_yn = 'N' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(jgc.selected_cost) FROM job_goal_course jgc WHERE jgc.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgc.del_yn = 'N' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(jgt.selected_cost) FROM job_goal_training jgt WHERE jgt.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgt.del_yn = 'N' ), 0) ) AS amount, CASE WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J01' THEN CONCAT('취업 ', jc1.category_name) WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J02' THEN CONCAT('공무원 ', jc1.category_name) WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J03' THEN '편입' ELSE NULL END AS detail, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN job_goal jg ON ub.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 2 AND jg.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN job_category jc ON jg.category_id = jc.category_id AND jc.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN job_category jc1 ON jc.parent_id = jc1.category_id AND jc1.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND jg.status = 'CONFIRMED'
UNION ALL
SELECT cg.goal_id AS goalId, 3 AS categoryId, CONCAT( cm.model_name, CASE WHEN cg.selected_year IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (', cg.selected_year, ')') ELSE '' END ) AS title, COALESCE(cm.base_price * 10000, 0) AS amount, CASE cg.car_type_code WHEN 1 THEN '경차' WHEN 2 THEN '준중형' WHEN 3 THEN 'SUV' ELSE NULL END AS detail, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN car_goal cg ON ub.goal_id = cg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 3 LEFT JOIN car_model cm ON cg.selected_model_id = cm.model_id AND cm.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND cg.status = 'confirmed'
UNION ALL
SELECT rg.goal_id AS goalId, 4 AS categoryId, COALESCE( NULLIF(rl.building_name, ''), NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', rc.umd_name, rl.estate_type), ''), rg.title, '자취 목표' ) AS title, NULL AS amount, CONCAT_WS(' ', rc.sido_name, rc.sigungu_name, rc.umd_name) AS detail, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN rent_goal rg ON ub.goal_id = rg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 4 AND rg.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN rent_listing rl ON rl.listing_id = rg.confirmed_listing_id AND rl.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN region_code rc ON rc.region_code = rl.region_code AND rc.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND rg.status = 'CONFIRMED' ) favorite ORDER BY favorite.bookmarkedDate DESC

SELECT category, title, schedule_date AS scheduleDate, DATEDIFF(schedule_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay FROM ( SELECT 'TRAVEL' AS category, tg.title AS title, tg.start_date AS schedule_date FROM travel_goal tg WHERE tg.user_id = #{userId} AND tg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND tg.del_yn = 'N' AND tg.start_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY tg.start_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS t1
UNION ALL
SELECT category, title, schedule_date AS scheduleDate, DATEDIFF(schedule_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay FROM ( SELECT 'JOB' AS category, CONCAT( jq.qual_name, IF(nearest.written_exam_start_date >= CURDATE(), ' 필기', ' 실기') ) AS title, nearest.exam_date AS schedule_date FROM job_goal jg INNER JOIN job_goal_qualification jgq ON jgq.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgq.del_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN job_qualification jq ON jq.qual_id = jgq.qual_id AND jq.del_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN ( SELECT s.qual_id, s.written_exam_start_date, IF(s.written_exam_start_date >= CURDATE(), s.written_exam_start_date, s.practical_exam_start_date) AS exam_date FROM job_qualification_schedule s WHERE s.del_yn = 'N' AND s.schedule_id = ( SELECT s2.schedule_id FROM job_qualification_schedule s2 WHERE s2.qual_id = s.qual_id AND s2.del_yn = 'N' AND ( s2.written_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() OR s2.practical_exam_end_date >= CURDATE() ) ORDER BY s2.exam_year, s2.schedule_id LIMIT 1 ) ) AS nearest ON nearest.qual_id = jq.qual_id WHERE jg.user_id = #{userId} AND jg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND jg.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY nearest.exam_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS t2
